title: A Model of Diverse Sampling from Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.25003v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language models often produce high-quality individual samples but poor sets, with repeated samples clustering around the same semantic modes. We formalize diverse generation as sampling a size-$K$ subset of complete strings from a determinantal point process (DPP), where the likelihood encodes item quality, and the embedding geometry encodes repulsion between similar outputs. Exact inference over all strings is intractable, so we propose PoolDPP: draw a finite candidate pool from a tractable proposal, importance-weight the candidates toward the target quality, and run a $K$-DPP sampler on the induced pool kernel; a greedy MAP variant provides deterministic selection. We prove a finite-sample bound with an explicit constant: the KL divergence between the sampler's output and the target $K$-DPP decays as O(1/N) in the pool size. Empirically, PoolDPP extends the quality--diversity frontier on open-ended generation and the precision--recal

translated_title: 一个语言模型多样性采样模型
translated_abstract: 语言模型通常能产生高质量的个体样本，但其样本集合往往质量不佳，重复样本聚集在相同的语义模式附近。我们将多样性生成形式化为从行列式点过程（DPP）中采样大小为 $K$ 的完整字符串子集，其中似然编码条目质量，嵌入几何结构编码相似输出之间的排斥作用。由于对所有字符串进行精确推理是不可行的，我们提出 PoolDPP：从一个易于处理的提议分布中抽取有限的候选池，通过重要性加权使候选偏向目标质量，然后在诱导的池核上运行 K-DPP 采样器；贪心 MAP 变体则提供确定性的选择方式。我们证明了一个具有显式常数的有限样本界：采样器输出与目标 $K$-DPP 之间的 KL 散度随池大小 $N$ 以 O(1/N) 的速度衰减。实证结果表明，PoolDPP 在开放式生成任务上扩展了质量-多样性边界，并提高了精确率-召回率……（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 PoolDPP 方法，将语言模型的多样性采样形式化为行列式点过程（DPP）下的子集采样，通过候选池上的 K-DPP 采样器实现了输出与目标分布间 KL 散度 O(1/N) 的收敛保证，并在实验中扩展了质量-多样性前沿。
en_tdlr: Proposes PoolDPP, which formalizes diverse sampling from language models as subset sampling under a determinantal point process, achieving O(1/N) KL-divergence convergence to the target K-DPP and empirically extending the quality–diversity frontier.
